# Anne Shirley & Janet

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Janet](../character/janet.md) — confidantes who share stories and conversation · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Philippa P2](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0002), [v3 ch.Last P24](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0024), [v3 ch.Last P47](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0047)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes a letter to Philippa describing her new boarding place at 'Wayside' with Miss [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet. She discusses the house, Janet's cooking, the awkward hired boy [Sam](../character/sam.md), and mentions an ongoing elderly love affair in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXI Anne to Philippa

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 ch.Philippa P5](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0005), [v3 ch.Philippa P8](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0008), [v3 ch.Philippa P9](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0009)_

> [Janet](../character/janet.md) tearfully confides in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) has been visiting her for twenty years without proposing. Encouraged by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to take a firm stand, [Janet](../character/janet.md) sharply rejects John's escort after prayer-meeting, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) immediately regrets her advice upon seeing John's heartbreak and rushes to reconcile them.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIII “He Just Kept Coming and Coming”

_Sources: [v3 ch.Coming” P4](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0004), [v3 ch.Coming” P17](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0017), [v3 ch.Coming” P23](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0023), [v3 ch.Coming” P27](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0027)_

> During her time in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives an awkward proposal from [Sam](../character/sam.md), which she politely rejects and later laughs about with [Janet](../character/janet.md). After John Douglas's mother passes away, [Alec](../character/alec.md) fetches [Janet](../character/janet.md), and John soon arrives to propose to [Janet](../character/janet.md), explaining that his mother forced him to promise to wait until her death before marrying or telling anyone.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIV John Douglas Speaks at Last

_Sources: [v3 ch.Last P12](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0012), [v3 ch.Last P20](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0020), [v3 ch.Last P26](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0026), [v3 ch.Last P36](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0036)_

> The girls return to Patty's Place for their final year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and unpack while catching up with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md). Later in the term, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) cheer themselves up during a rainy evening by reading old, overly tragic stories written during their [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) days in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXV The Last Redmond Year Opens

_Sources: [v3 ch.Opens P0](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0000), [v3 ch.Opens P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 ch.Opens P30](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0030), [v3 ch.Opens P44](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0044)_
